contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP ANTO NINVS AVG ; R/ TEMPORE [---]AS

Possibly Base Silver, possibly a Denarius of Caracalla (198-217), Reece period 10, possibly Rome mint. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: IMP ANTO NINVS AVG. Reverse description: Draped figure standing left holding cornucopiae and sceptre or staff with object on top, perhaps a pileus. Reverse inscription: TEMPORE [---]AS. Diameter: 17.6mm, Weight:…
